page.layout: One printed page, a centred dedication block on the left; the right edge shows the neighbouring page and is left out.

main_text.l: ob multa, à multis annis exhibita, bene-

page.notes: Faint show-through of mirrored text from the reverse (top centre, and near the centre of the block) is left out. The neighbouring page's edge at the right is left out. The reading "hostimenti" is doubtful and may be a printing error for a word such as "hospitii"; it is copied as read. The name "Ludovicus" has a small stylised mark in the printed "o" position; it is copied as "Ludovicus". The page's bottom imprint (printer's name and date, very faint and partly rubbed) is not legible enough to transcribe and is left out.
